benchmarks.application: Compare eligibility and mentorship with actual access to money. Reimbursement requirements may create a cash-flow barrier even where a program targets low-income applicants. Treat this as a question to investigate, not a measured outcome of this program. Preserve cohort records separately from testimonials and evaluated business results.

Use named practitioner cases to locate original museum programs and evaluations. Distinguish participation, reported experience and measured health outcomes; the conference announcement alone does not validate effectiveness.

Consider film, discussion, walks and exhibitions as complementary ways of examining the built environment. A film is an authored representation, not neutral proof, and requires its own provenance and rights context.

Keep evidence, uncertainties, constructed scenarios and fictional artifacts visibly separate. Compare how decisions perform across several possible conditions rather than promoting one desired future as inevitable. Sponsorship and participant-selection limitations should remain visible.
